subject: general
question: Tanras Khan is associated with which of the following gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tanras Khan was a prominent figure associated with the **Delhi Gharana** of Hindustani classical music.
 
• He was known for his expertise in **tabla** and for establishing a systematic approach to tabla compositions.
 
• The Delhi Gharana is considered the oldest tabla gharana, with a focus on clarity, precision, and intricate rhythmic structures.
 
• Tanras Khan was instrumental in shaping the rhythmic patterns (kaidas and tukras) of the Delhi Gharana, which are still widely practiced today.
 
• The gharana's influence extends beyond tabla to vocal and instrumental music, reflecting a holistic approach to rhythm and melody.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi Gharana:**

 
 
• One of the oldest tabla gharanas, established in the 18th century.
 
• It emphasizes a balance of tonal clarity and rhythmic complexity in its compositions.
 
• Key contributions include kaidas, tukras, and parans that are foundational to modern tabla playing.
 
 
 
• **Tabla Gharanas:**
 
 
• There are six prominent tabla gharanas: Delhi, Lucknow, Benaras, Ajrada, Farrukhabad, and Punjab.
 
• Each gharana has a distinct style of playing, composition, and teaching.
 
 
 
• **Role of Gharanas in Hindustani Classical Music:**
 
 
• Gharanas represent a lineage or school of music with distinct styles and techniques.
 
• They preserve and pass down traditional knowledge and innovations in music and dance.
 
 
 
• **Tanras Khan's Legacy:**
 
 
• His contributions to the Delhi Gharana have made it a cornerstone of tabla tradition.
 
• He played a pivotal role in standardizing tabla compositions, ensuring their survival and transmission over generations.
